name: hackability-shelter
description: SHELTER-WALLS: the 2D Hackability overlay must tint a household shelter's RC walls NOT PERMITTED (red), not 'unclassified'. Loads tpl-hdb-4room, whose shelter walls are undeclared internal partitions, opens the plan editor and turns on the overlay. Pro-tier (hackabilityOverlay flag).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-flag-on
steps.failMessage: hackabilityOverlay should be ON in Pro

steps.name: editor-swap-settled
steps.failMessage: the deferred scene swap never settled — FloorPlanEditor mounts on visualScene.floorPlan, which waits for the loading overlay to clear

steps.name: open-view-menu
steps.eval: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='View ▾'); if(!b) throw new Error('no View menu button'); b.click(); return 'opened'})()

steps.name: toggle-hackability
steps.eval: (()=>{const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; const b=all.find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Hackability'); if(!b) throw new Error('buttons on page: '+all.map(x=>x.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,60).join(' | ')); b.click(); return b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')})()

steps.name: assert-shelter-walls-red
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState(); return import('/src/floorplan/wallHackability.ts').then(m=>{const plan=s.floorPlan; const ids=[...m.shelterWallIds(plan)]; if(ids.length===0) throw new Error('no shelter walls found'); const bad=ids.filter(id=>{const w=plan.walls.find(x=>x.id===id); return m.wallHackability(m.establishedWallStructureInPlan(w, new Set(ids)))!=='no'}); if(bad.length) throw new Error('not classified: '+bad.join(',')); return ids.length+' shelter walls classified not-permitted'})})()
